member.name: M:EFTranslatable.HasTranslations`1.Translate(System.String)
member.summary: Creates a new instance of the entity with all Translatable properties set to the specified locale. Non-translatable properties are copied as-is to the new instance.
member.param: The target locale code (e.g., "en", "ar", "fr") to translate all Translatable properties to
member.returns: A new entity instance with all Translatable properties configured for the specified locale
member.remarks:
This method uses reflection to iterate through all properties of the entity. For Translatable properties: - Null values are safely handled by creating empty Translatable instances - The locale is set using WithLocale() which affects the implicit string conversion - The original entity's properties remain unchanged
For non-Translatable properties: - Values are copied by reference to the new instance
This method is null-safe and will not throw NullReferenceException even if Translatable properties contain null values from the database.

member.name: M:EFTranslatable.Translatable.Get(System.String)
member.summary: Returns the translated value for the specified locale with intelligent fallback logic
member.param: The locale code to retrieve (e.g., "en", "ar", "fr"). If null, the CurrentLocale will be used. If CurrentLocale is null, the current Thread's UI culture will be used. If no translation is found for the requested locale, the FallbackLocale will be used. If FallbackLocale is not set or not found, the first available translation will be used.
member.returns: The translated string for the specified locale, or an empty string if no translation is available. Never returns null.
member.remarks: This method includes comprehensive null safety checks. If Translations is null, an empty string is returned immediately. The fallback logic ensures that a valid string is always returned, preventing NullReferenceExceptions in consuming code.
